submission.reasoning: On workstation5, user WORKSTATION5\wardog opened an interactive cmd.exe (proc-29da349e7e) with high integrity. From it, they ran bitsadmin.exe (proc-826bdb1e01) to start a foreground BITS transfer job. The job downloaded a file from raw.githubusercontent.com (the Atomic Red Team T1197 page) and saved it as C:\Users\wardog\AppData\Local\Temp\bitsadmin1_flag.ps1. Using BITS to pull content from the internet and save it as a .ps1 script in the user's Temp folder matches MITRE T1197 (BITS Jobs) and ingress tool transfer. This looks like an adversary-emulation run, but the behavior is malicious. The graph has no file entity for the downloaded file, so its creation is not confirmed. Next steps: isolate the host, reset the user's password and delete the downloaded file if it exists.
